A slow-moving, harmless snail with a green shell. The first monster most adventurers ever defeat.

Critical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down. Required Skill: At least Level 5 on Bow Mastery
Fires an arrow with authority. Applies more damage than usual.

Fires an arrow with a bomb attached to it. If struck cleanly, the bomb explodes on the enemy, stunning some enemies around with a certain success rate. Can't attack more than 4 at once, and it only works with a bow equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped axe. It only applies when a one-handed or a two-handed axe is equipped.
Increases Axe Mastery, and attacks have a chance to inflict a bleeding effect on the target when attacking. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed axe is equipped.
Temporarily increases the Accuracy, Avoidability, and HP recovery from items and skills of all party members around the area.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped blunt weapon. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed blunt weapon is equipped.
Increases Blunt Weapon Mastery and Attack Power, with a chance to stun the target when attacking. This skill only applies when a one-handed or two-handed blunt weapon is equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped bow. It only applies when a bow is equipped.
Increases Bow Mastery and Avoidability. This effect only applies when a bow is equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped claw. It only applies when the character is equipped with a claw and throwing stars.
Increases Claw Mastery and Attack Power, and gives a chance to recover used throwing stars when using throwing star attacks. Only applies when a claw is equipped.

Attacks a single monster with a sharp piece of ice. dealing ice-elemental damage. All monsters except those strong against ice will be briefly slowed when hit. Deals reduced damage to ice-based enemies and increased damage to fire-based enemies.
Recovers additional HP and MP with a certain chance when landing a critical hit. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.
Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped crossbow. It only applies when a crossbow is equipped.
Increases Crossbow Mastery and gives a chance to deal damage that ignores the target’s Weapon Def. This effect only applies when a crossbow is equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped dagger. It only applies when a dagger is equipped.
Increases Dagger Mastery and Critical Rate, with a chance to ignore knockback effects. It only applies when a dagger is equipped.
Use MP to hide behind the shadows. Can't be attacked, and can't attack either. The effect is activated when used and deactivated when used again.
Temporarily decreases the Attack Power and Weapon Def. of an enemy and dissuades it from attacking you. Has no effect on a monster that's already in "Disorder."
Fires two arrows at once to attack up to two enemies.
Use MP to quickly stab a monster twice in one turn using a dagger.
Absorbs some of the damage dished out to the enemy as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy.
Use MP to attack one enemy. The higher the Mastery, the lower the damage variation.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to up to three enemies. This skill only activates when a one-handed or two-handed axe is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy. This skill only activates when a one-handed or two-handed blunt weapon is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to up to three enemies. This skill only activates when a bow is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy. This skill only activates when a crossbow is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to the enemy and absorbing a portion of the damage dealt as HP. The amount absorbed per activation cannot exceed 25% of the character’s Max HP or the enemy’s Max HP. This skill only activates when a polearm is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to the enemy and absorbing a portion of the damage dealt as HP. The amount absorbed per activation cannot exceed 25% of the character’s Max HP or the enemy’s Max HP. This skill only activates when a spear is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to up to three enemies. This skill only activates when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

While the effect is active, using attack skills has a chance to activate Final Attack, dealing heavy damage to up to three enemies. This skill only activates when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped. Using the skill activates the effect, and using it again deactivates it.

Creates a fire arrow using magic power and fires it at a single enemy. The enemy hit takes fire-elemental damage and is burned, receiving continuous damage every second for 3 seconds. Deals reduced damage to fire-based enemies and increased damage to ice-based enemies.
Focus to temporarily increase Accuracy and Avoidability.
Temporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.
Temporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.
Recovers the HP of all party members around the area. The amount of healing depends on the number of people being healed, and undead monsters around the area will receive damage.
Attacks monsters by firing holy arrows. Very effective against the undead or devil-based monsters.
HP naturally regenerates over time, not just when standing still. Also, HP recovery from items and skills is boosted.
The amount of MP that naturally regenerates over time increases. Also, MP recovery from items and skills is boosted.
Reduces physical damage taken for a certain duration, and deals non-elemental magic damage to any monster that takes contact damage from the caster.
Attacks up to 4 monsters at once with a powerful arrow, which penetrates through them. Damage decreases as the arrow flies through each monster.
Temporarily increases your Weapon Defense.
Temporarily increases the user's Weapon Defense and grants a chance to ignore knockback effects.
Increases attack range for throwing weapons such as throwing stars & knives.
Use MP to throw 2 throwing stars and apply damage based on LUK, regardless of the rate of Claw Mastery.
Absorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy’s MP is 0.
Absorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy’s MP is 0.
Absorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy’s MP is 0.
Temporarily boosts Weapon Def. and Magic Def. by concentrating magic into your armor.
Use MP to attack an enemy twice. The higher the Mastery, the lower the damage variation.
Replaces a portion of incoming damage with MP instead of HP. If MP reaches 0, all damage is received as HP damage. The effect is activated when used and deactivated when used again.
Max HP increases.
Max MP increases.
Meditate for a bit to temporarily increase the Magic Attack of party members around the area.
Meditate for a bit to temporarily increase the Magic Attack of party members around the area.
Increases Accuracy and Avoidability.
Enables the character to move around quickly for a short amount of time.
Recover HP and MP with a certain chance when evading. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.

Creates a poison droplet and fires it at a single enemy. When it hits, the droplet explodes on contact, dealing poison-elemental damage to up to 4 nearby enemies. 
Enemies hit have a chance to become poisoned for a certain duration.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped polearm. It only applies when a polearm is equipped.
Increases Polearm Mastery and movement speed. It only applies when a polearm is equipped.
Swings the bow widely to push multiple enemies far back. This attack always hits as a critical, and as the level rises, the number of monsters that one can push back with one swing increases.
Use MP to deliver a killer blow to a single monster with your weapon.
Repeated practice with your weapon has increased your Accuracy and Critical Rate.
Temporarily increases the Attack Power of everyone in the party around the area, but also decreases Weapon Def.
Enables the user to recover HP constantly for 30 sec.

Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 4 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.

Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 4 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.

Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 4 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.
Use MP to attack an enemy up to 6 times in a row with a dagger.
Use HP and MP to attack up to 4 enemies around you with your weapon.
Temporarily slows down the movement of up to 4 monsters. Cannot be used on the same monsters more than twice in a row.
Temporarily slows down the movement of up to 4 monsters. Cannot be used on the same monsters more than twice in a row.
Temporarily allows the character to fire bow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a bow equipped.
Temporarily allows the character to fire crossbow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a crossbow equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped spear. It only applies when a spear is equipped.
Increases Spear Mastery and Avoidability. It only applies when a spear is equipped.

Steals one of the monster's items with a given success rate. On success, stuns the enemy for 1.5 seconds and increases Attack Power for 30 seconds. Stealing works only once against the same monster, and can be attempted until successful.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped sword. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.
Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped sword. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.
Increases Sword Mastery and Accuracy. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.
Increases Sword Mastery and Accuracy. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.
Use the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.
Use the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.
Use the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.
Increases attack range for bows and crossbows.
Use MP to temporarily threaten monsters. Decreases the Movement Speed, Weapon Attack, and Weapon Def. of up to 4 monsters around the area.
Hurls snail shells to attack monsters from long distance.
Attacks surrounding monsters with a thunderbolt, dealing lightning-elemental damage. All monsters, except those resistant to lightning, have a chance to be stunned by electrocution.
